title: Coming back after an absence
summary: For people returning from reserve duty, parental leave, illness or other time away.
body: Returning can feel strange. Things have changed, you may be tired, and it can be hard to find your feet at once.
Ask for a short catch-up on what changed, and for a phased workload for the first weeks if that would help. It is a reasonable request.
Expect some adjustment. You do not have to prove yourself in the first week.
If you came back from something demanding, such as military service, it is common to need time to switch between very different environments. Support is available if you want it.
